A Qoder PAT (`pt-...`) is stored through the Models page and exchanged per process for a shor"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" (`pt-...`) is stored through the Models page and exchanged per process for a short-lived job token."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-alpha.1` or newer in the `0.2.x` line and pnpm. Verified against th"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"e official `0.2.1-alpha.2` runtime."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Open **Settings → Models → Qoder CN → Edit connection**. This card ships with the plugin and uses th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e official Models-page extension slot; no Harness source patch is required. Enter a PAT, and optiona"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"lly an enterprise VPC instance ID. Leave the instance empty for the public CN cloud. Advanced settin"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"gs allow explicit Gateway and OpenAPI URLs."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The card never reads back the PAT. Leaving its input empty preserves the existing credential; enviro"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nment-owned credentials are read-only. Connection changes take effect on the next request. If config"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"uration saves but credential storage fails, the card keeps the token draft and reports the partial s"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ave for retry. A stale configuration revision is rejected before writing a token."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The unscoped npm package `dsh-provider-qoder` belongs to a different project. This implementation is"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" published as `@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder`; `github:minglu6/dsh-provider-qoder` remains an alter"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"native source. To link a local checkout after building:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart the Web profile after installing or rebuilding the plugin's browser bundle."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"For Desktop, fully quit the application and replace `--profile web` with `--profile desktop`. When m"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"igrating this implementation from an older GitHub/tarball install named `dsh-provider-qoder`, replac"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"e that dependency and its `dsh.profile.bundles` entry with the scoped name; also update the existing"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" `llm-qoder` entry's package `name` to `@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder`. Preserve that entry's conne"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ction configuration, credential references, and all credential storage. Do not load both names at on"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"on configuration, credential references, and all credential storage. Do not load both names at once."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Remove:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"From a DeepSeek Harness checkout:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The bundle mounts the `llm-qoder` entry. Its live configuration is persisted through DSH's profile `"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"cordis.patch.yml`, and PATs are stored through the DSH credentials service. The default credential r"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"eference is `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`; a launch environment can supply that reference instead."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"An existing `providers.qoder-cn` profile overrides only the fields it declares and inherits other ro"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ot fields. The card edits that profile when present, otherwise the root. An explicit empty VPC insta"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"nce selects public cloud instead of an inherited or environment-provided tenant. Empty URL overrides"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" derive endpoints from the selected VPC or public cloud. Advanced configuration and model overrides "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"not edited by the card are preserved."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Unless `models` is configured, the adapter fetches Qoder's signed live catalog from `/algo/api/v2/mo"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"del/list` whenever DSH lists the provider. Model IDs are the upstream `key`, and labels are the upst"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ream `display_name` (or the key when no name is supplied). Generation sends that same key unchanged "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"in its headers and body. Distinct keys remain distinct even when their display names match."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Exact-model resolution reuses the latest successful catalog in the current process. The DSH browser "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"also caches its model selector catalog: opening the menu repeatedly does not poll Qoder. Reload the "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"page to request a fresh catalog, or let settings, credentials, or adapter changes trigger its refres"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ge to request a fresh catalog, or let settings, credentials, or adapter changes trigger its refresh."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`models` remains an optional complete static override for deployments that intentionally pin the sel"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ector catalog. Every configured `id` must be an upstream wire key. This list replaces live discovery"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" rather than extending it. Authentication failures surface as `AUTH` (and a rejected job-token sessi"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"on is dropped and retried once after a fresh exchange), transport, invalid JSON, and empty-catalog f"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ailures surface as discovery errors instead of falling back to a built-in list."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Model-ID migration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Saved selections or static catalogs using versioned aliases such as `qwen3.6-flash`, `kimi-k2.6`, or"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" `glm-5.2` must be reselected from the live directory or changed to the intended upstream key. Do no"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"t infer the key from an old version label: Qoder can rename or replace the model behind a key. `auto"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"` is unchanged. Historical session logs are not rewritten. The `getQoderCNDirectModel` helper is no "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"longer exported; callers send the selected upstream key directly."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Tool-call history compatibility"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Qoder can reject tool results when the preceding assistant message contains only tool calls and has "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"`content: null`. The adapter adds a non-empty `(tool call)` marker to that assistant message on the "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"wire, preserving call IDs, arguments, result order, and stored session history. Existing text and re"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"asoning remain unchanged. After installing the updated plugin and restarting the Host, affected conv"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ersations can be retried without rewriting their history."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"In-band upstream errors expose the nested provider message and gateway request ID rather than trunca"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ting the JSON wrapper before the actionable detail. Error classification and authentication retry be"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"havior are unchanged."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Streaming reasoning and incomplete responses"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The adapter incrementally recognizes `<thinking>`, `<think>`, `<reasoning>`, and `<thought>` across "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"stream boundaries, even if upstream emits them with reasoning disabled. Ordinary text, whitespace, n"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ative reasoning, and structured tool calls are preserved."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"A normal stop containing only reasoning, or unclosed tagged reasoning without a structured tool call"},{"id":"p31s2","text":", finishes with `QODER_INCOMPLETE_RESPONSE` rather than reporting success. Partial reasoning remains"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" available as evidence; orphan DSML fragments are not converted into invented tool calls. Real tool "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"calls and length-limit termination retain their normal behavior. This guard does not retry requests "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"-limit termination retain their normal behavior. This guard does not retry requests or replay tools."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Remote sessions and unsolicited checkpoints"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":true}
